fuse_graph_module: fuse a PyTorch GraphModule by matching fusion patterns and returning a fused GraphModule
find_fusion_matches: find matching fusion patterns in a PyTorch graph and return a node-to-handler match map
build_fusion_handler: build a FuseHandler instance to fuse matched graph nodes into a single operation
test_fusion_patterns: test the fuse function with a GraphModule, is_qat flag, and optional backend config
refactor_fusion_config: refactor the fuse call to use FuseCustomConfig and BackendConfig objects instead of dicts
